speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me when the swelling and pain in your right ring finger first started, and did it happen after any injury?

text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; the mechanism of injury sounds like a possible joint dislocation or tendon injury. Can you describe the exact location of the pain and swelling, and are you able to fully bend or straighten the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: The inability to flex the fingertip after a jersey pull suggests a likely flexor digitorum profundus tendon avulsion, often called a "jersey finger." REQUEST TEST: Right Ring Finger X-Ray.
